text:
leah: Quick shoutout — infra pulled a last-minute rollback during the client demo and totally saved the day. Huge thanks to everyone who stayed late :heart:

sandeep: appreciate it! everyone on infra rallied. special props to @maria and @devon for the perf triage and hotfixes :raised_hands:

maria: teamwork ftw. glad we caught the memory spike early. also shoutout to @elena for re-making the demo clip so we could re-run it :tada:

max: cheers to infra + design. you all made the demo look polished under pressure. coffee and cookies on me next week :coffee:

elena: lol i'll take the cookies. happy to help with edits — minor miracle it rendered in time :sweat_smile:

kudos-bot: Awarded 5 kudos to sandeep, 3 kudos to maria, 2 kudos to devon — reason: demo rescue :sparkles:

jordan: Love this. quick question: anyone up for a celebratory boba run today? i'm offering first round :bubble_tea:

devon: count me in. 3pm lobby? :clock3: :raised_hands:

leah: 3pm works. meeting room after stand? :+1:

ops-bot: Reminder: please drop any postmortem notes in #postmortems and tag the oncall rotation so we can capture follow-ups.

maria: added a couple of timing graphs and the patch link. thanks again team — y'all rock :metal:

leah: seriously — big love. :heart_eyes:
